description: This file defines the CompilationResult class within the ScssPhp\ScssPhp namespace. The class encapsulates the outcome of a SCSS compilation, including the generated CSS, source map, and included files.

classes.name: CompilationResult
classes.description: A class representing the result of compiling SCSS to CSS, including the CSS output, optional source map, and included files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CompilationResult with CSS content, source map, and included files.

methods.name: getIncludedFiles
methods.description: Returns an array of included file paths.

methods.name: getSourceMap
methods.description: Returns the source map string if available, otherwise null.
